faq.question: What is the admission fee and is it refundable?
faq.answer: The admission fee is Rs. 50,000 and is non-refundable. This is a one-time fee paid at the time of enrollment.

faq.question: Do you offer sibling discounts?
faq.answer: Yes, we offer a 10% discount on tuition fees for the second child. The discount applies from the year of enrollment of the second child.

faq.question: What curriculum do you follow?
faq.answer: We follow CBSE curriculum enriched with Cambridge International elements. Students in Grade 9-12 can opt for Cambridge AS/A Levels alongside CBSE.

faq.question: Is transport available from all parts of Bangalore?
faq.answer: We have 8 bus routes covering major areas including Whitefield, Koramangala, HSR Layout, Indiranagar, Hebbal, Jayanagar, Electronic City, and Rajajinagar. All buses are AC with GPS tracking.

faq.question: What is the student-teacher ratio?
faq.answer: Our student-teacher ratio is 20:1. For pre-primary sections, we maintain a lower ratio of 15:1 with an additional classroom assistant.

faq.question: Do you have after-school programs?
faq.answer: Yes, we offer after-school activities from 3:30 PM to 5:00 PM including robotics, music, dance, art, swimming, and foreign languages (French, German, Japanese).

faq.question: What safety measures are in place?
faq.answer: We have 200+ CCTV cameras, biometric entry for staff, visitor management system, boundary wall with electric fencing, and 24/7 security guards. All buses have GPS tracking and female attendants.

faq.question: Can I visit the school before applying?
faq.answer: Absolutely! Campus visits are available Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 4 PM. You can schedule a visit through our AI voice agent or call the admissions office directly.

faq.question: What if my child needs special attention or has learning differences?
faq.answer: We have a dedicated Special Education Needs (SEN) team with 3 trained counselors. Individual Education Plans (IEPs) are created for students who need additional support.

faq.question: When does the academic year start?
faq.answer: The academic year starts in June. For 2026-27, the session begins on June 10, 2026. Applications are open from January 15 to April 30, 2026.
